Allow.Slots.names_do_not_affect_payload: ∀ (p : Allow.Slots.Presented) (labels : Allow.Slots.Slot → String), Allow.Slots.anonymous {p with names := labels} = Allow.Slots.anonymous p
Allow.Slots.names_do_not_affect_embeddin: ∀ (p : Allow.Slots.Presented) (labels : Allow.Slots.Slot → String) (source origin : String), Allow.Slots.embedding {p with names := labels, source := source, origin := origin} = Allow.Slots.embedding p
Allow.Slots.distinct_slots_remain_distin: ∀ (a b : Allow.Slots.Slot), a ≠ b → Allow.Slots.Tree.reference a ≠ Allow.Slots.Tree.reference b
Allow.Foundation.admission_bounded: ∀ {active capacity next : Nat}, Allow.Foundation.admit active capacity = some next → next ≤ capacity
Allow.Foundation.terminal_is_final: ∀ (prior incoming : Allow.SolverStatus), Allow.Foundation.finish (.terminal prior) incoming = .terminal prior
Allow.Foundation.accepted_style_bounded: ∀ {m : Allow.Foundation.MethodMetadata}, Allow.Foundation.acceptable m = true → m.lines ≤ 30 ∧ m.documented = true ∧ m.encapsulated = true
